summary: Brazil Codigo Penal Art. 121 s3 punishes homicidio culposo by 1-3 years detencao (+1/3 for professional-rule breach or failure to render aid); a custodial construct giving a clean bounded intent ratio of ~6-6.7x.
label_raw: Negligent homicide / homicidio culposo (Art. 121 s3): 1-3 years detencao; +1/3 for professional breach or failure to aid
source_citation: Brazil, Codigo Penal Decreto-Lei 2.848/1940 Art. 121 s3 (jurishand.com)

summary: Brazil Codigo Penal Art. 121 caput punishes homicidio doloso by 6-20 years reclusao; a custodial construct, no death penalty for ordinary homicide.
label_raw: Intentional homicide / homicidio doloso (Art. 121 caput): 6-20 years reclusao
source_citation: Brazil, Codigo Penal Decreto-Lei 2.848/1940 Art. 121 caput (jurishand.com; Wikipedia: Murder in Brazilian law)

summary: China PRC Criminal Law Art. 232 punishes intentional homicide by death, life, or fixed term >=10 years (3-10 years if circumstances relatively minor); a custodial/capital construct, not monetary compensation.
label_raw: Intentional homicide (Art. 232): death, life, or fixed-term >=10 years; 3-10 years if circumstances relatively minor

summary: China PRC Criminal Law Art. 233 punishes negligently causing death by 3-7 years (<=3 years if minor); a custodial construct whose 7-year cap sits below the intentional 10-year floor, giving a within-jurisdiction intent ratio of ~3.3x.
label_raw: Negligently causing death (Art. 233): 3-7 years; <=3 years if circumstances minor

summary: Egypt Penal Code Art. 230 punishes premeditated murder by death (operating alongside qisas, with heirs' pardon able to substitute); a capital construct with mixed Islamic/civil-law character, the top intent tier.
label_raw: Premeditated murder (Art. 230): death penalty (alongside qisas; heirs' pardon can substitute)
source_citation: Egypt, Penal Code Law No. 58 of 1937 Art. 230 (EIPR, The Death Penalty in Egyptian Law)

summary: Egypt Penal Code Art. 234 punishes deliberate killing without premeditation by permanent or temporary hard labour (death if accompanied by another felony); a custodial construct, the middle intent tier.
label_raw: Deliberate killing without premeditation (Art. 234): permanent or temporary hard labour; death if with another felony
source_citation: Egypt, Penal Code Law No. 58 of 1937 Art. 234 (UNODC SHERLOC)

summary: Egypt Penal Code Art. 238 punishes causing death by negligence/recklessness by >=6 months plus a nominal EGP 200 fine (1937 figure, ~cents in 2024 USD and inflation-voided), rising to 5-10 years for aggravators; a custodial construct illustrating that nominal monetary penalties in old codes are not reliable calibration anchors.
label_raw: Causing death by negligence/recklessness (Art. 238): >=6 months and/or fine up to EGP 200 base; up to 5 years if under influence; 1-7 years if >=3 victims; 1-10 years if intoxicated with mass casualties
source_citation: Egypt, Penal Code Law No. 58 of 1937 Art. 238 (Ahram Online); EGP 200 is the 1937 nominal figure, negligible in 2024 USD

summary: Indonesia KUHP Art. 338 punishes pembunuhan (murder) by a maximum 15 years; a custodial construct, the middle tier of a three-level intent ladder.
source_citation: Indonesia, KUHP / Penal Code 1918 Art. 338 (icnl.org KUHP English)

summary: Indonesia KUHP Art. 340 punishes pembunuhan berencana (premeditated murder) by death, life, or up to 20 years; a custodial/capital construct escalating intentional killing to a premeditated top tier.
label_raw: Premeditated murder / pembunuhan berencana (Art. 340): death, life, or up to 20 years

summary: Indonesia KUHP Art. 359 punishes negligence causing death by a maximum 5 years (or 1 year detention); a custodial construct giving a ~3x intent ratio against plain murder's 15-year cap.
label_raw: Negligence causing death (Art. 359): max 5 years (or 1 year detention)

summary: Mexico Codigo Penal Federal Arts. 302+307 punish homicidio doloso simple by 12-24 years; a custodial construct, no death penalty (abolished 2005), the intentional anchor.
label_raw: Intentional homicide / homicidio doloso simple (Arts. 302+307): 12-24 years
source_citation: Mexico, Codigo Penal Federal Arts. 302+307 (Justia Mexico Arts. 302-309)

summary: Mexico Codigo Penal Federal Art. 60 caps culpa-based penalties at 1/4 of the corresponding intentional penalty (roughly ~3-6 years for basic homicidio culposo); a custodial construct that structurally fixes the intent multiplier at ~4x by design.
label_raw: Negligent homicide / homicidio culposo: Art. 60 caps at 1/4 of intentional penalty, ~3-6 years for basic culposo
source_citation: Mexico, Codigo Penal Federal Arts. 60+302 (Justia Mexico); culposo term derived via Art. 60 1/4 rule, state codes vary

summary: Nigeria (Northern states) Penal Code s. 221 punishes culpable homicide punishable with death by death; a capital construct with an Islamic-law overlay, the intentional anchor.
label_raw: Culpable homicide punishable with death (s. 221): death
source_citation: Nigeria (North), Penal Code (Northern States) Federal Provisions Act 1959 s. 221 (ilga.org PDF)

summary: Nigeria (Northern states) Penal Code s. 224 punishes culpable homicide not punishable with death (covering rash/negligent acts per s. 220(c)) by life or any lesser term plus possible fine; a custodial construct with Islamic-law overlay, unbounded intent tail against the death tier.
label_raw: Culpable homicide NOT punishable with death (s. 224, covers rash/negligent acts s. 220(c)): life imprisonment or any lesser term, plus possible fine
source_citation: Nigeria (North), Penal Code (Northern States) Federal Provisions Act 1959 ss. 224/220 (Mondaq: Murder, Culpable Homicide in Nigeria)

summary: Nigeria (Southern states) Criminal Code Act s. 319 imposes a mandatory death sentence for murder (under-17 offenders detained during the Governor's pleasure); a capital construct, the intentional anchor.
label_raw: Murder (s. 319): mandatory death sentence; under-17 detained during Governor's pleasure
source_citation: Nigeria, Criminal Code Act Cap. C38 s. 319 (jurist.ng/criminal_code_act/sec-319)

summary: Nigeria (Southern states) Criminal Code Act s. 325 (defined s. 317) makes manslaughter liable to life imprisonment with court discretion to impose less; a custodial construct bundling reckless/negligent killing without a low fixed cap, so the intent multiplier is effectively unbounded against the mandatory death tier.
label_raw: Manslaughter (s. 325, defined s. 317): liable to life imprisonment, court discretion to impose less
source_citation: Nigeria, Criminal Code Act Cap. C38 ss. 317/325 (jurist.ng/criminal_code_act/sec-317, sec-325)

summary: Russia Criminal Code Art. 105 s1 punishes simple murder by 6-15 years; a custodial construct forming the intentional anchor against negligent Art. 109.
source_citation: Russia, Criminal Code No. 63-FZ Art. 105 s1 (Wikipedia: Murder in Russian law)

summary: Russia Criminal Code Art. 105 s2 punishes aggravated murder by 8-20 years, life, or death (death under standing moratorium since 1996/1999); a custodial/capital construct reserving the unbounded tail for intentional killing.
label_raw: Murder, aggravated (Art. 105 s2): 8-20 years, life, or death (death penalty under moratorium)
source_citation: Russia, Criminal Code No. 63-FZ Art. 105 s2 (Wikipedia: Murder in Russian law)

summary: Russia Criminal Code Art. 109 punishes causing death by negligence at up to 2 years (3 if via professional duty breach, 4 if >=2 victims); a custodial construct yielding a ~3x intent ratio against simple murder's 6-year floor.
label_raw: Causing death by negligence (Art. 109): up to 2 years; up to 3 if professional duty breach; up to 4 if >=2 victims
source_citation: Russia, Criminal Code No. 63-FZ Art. 109 (legal-tools.org PDF); sub-tiers from secondary summaries
